purpose: Stricter parent storage gate: no raw text, per-unit IDs, order, source linkage or fingerprints when rawSavingOff
exportOff: Counts, aggregate ink counts, fixed shape enums, times, delays and bounded aggregate mechanism metadata only. No body ID/ink sequence, origin sequence/epoch, raw text/query, dictionary or text fingerprint.
exportOn: Explicit rawSavingOff=false may export bounded committed body ID/text/ink; this is not the no-saving path.
evaluation: Replay exposed R1 streams; compare all scheduler metrics and state outcomes to preserved R1 results. This is regression, not new unseen evaluation.
adoptionLimit: Candidate metadata serializer only; no authenticated privacy/IME/input adapter, no existing widget integration, no body-ID authority resolution.
